newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED WIN CHARITY SHIELD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED WIN CHARITY SHIELD.

text.p: Result of the F.A. Charity Shield
Manchester United won 4-2 on on penalties

Manchester United - 1-Peter Schmeichel, 3-Denis Irwin, 5- Ronnie Johnsen, 6-Gary Pallister, 8-Nicky Butt, 9-Andy Cole 10- Teddy Sheringham (substitute 14-Jordi Cruyff 72), 11-Ryan Giggs (7-David Beckham 72), 12-Phil Neville, 16-Roy Keane, 18-Paul Scholes.

Chelsea - 1-Ed De Goey, 5-Frank Leboeuf, 6-Steve Clarke, 8- Gustavo Poyet, 10-Mark Hughes (9-Gianluca Vialli 76), 11-Denis Wise, 16-Roberto Di Matteo, 17-Danny Granville, 20-Frank Sinclair, 25-Gianfranco Zola, 28-Jody Morris (2-Dan Petrescu 46).
